findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/graft-admit.ts::writemarkers emits eligible action markers on routes the deleted prose never recorded, contradicting rule 19
findings.title: writeMarkers emits eligible action markers on routes the deleted prose never recorded, contradicting rule 19
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec's section 3 marker table, accepted by the human, prescribes an eligible marker on needs-prep, needs-human and excluded; the code follows the table. Row 19's shorter wording is the spec's own imprecision. FAFF-1434's full replay is where the corpus semantics of these markers get compared.
